Our Core Hypothesis

As software development accelerates, the bottleneck shifts from code creation to engineering coordination, verification, and trust. ForgeMind acts as the intelligence and coordination layer across this lifecycle.

Continuous Intelligence Loop

ForgeMind creates a closed feedback loop that gets smarter with every software change.

01

OBSERVE

Monitor PRs, builds, deployments, incidents, and commits across all sources.

02

UNDERSTAND

Analyze changes, build failures, and anomalies with context-aware agents.

03

CORRELATE

Connect related events across the engineering lifecycle into coherent stories.

04

DECIDE

Evaluate impact, risk, and priority using structured reasoning.

05

ACT / ESCALATE

Execute low-risk actions autonomously; route high-impact decisions for approval.

06

LEARN

Capture outcomes, refine models, and improve future decisions.

Five-Tier Hierarchical Architecture

A strict five-tier DAG with supervisor, domain managers, specialist workers, validator, and decision reducer — orchestrated by Google ADK 2 on Cloud Run.

👁️
Tier 1

Engineering Supervisor

Global lifecycle coordination

  • Coverage plan generation
  • Domain partitioning
  • Global constraint enforcement
🧭
Tier 2

Domain Managers ×3

Bounded domain coordination

  • Code Intelligence Manager
  • Delivery Health Manager
  • Production Health Manager
⚙️
Tier 3

Specialist Workers ×6

Deep evidence extraction

  • PR Pre-Flight AST
  • Docs Drift & Spec
  • Build Log & Flakiness
  • Alert Storm Clustering
  • Telemetry Correlation
  • Security & Dependency
🔍
Tier 4

Cross-Lifecycle Validator

Multi-domain reconciliation

  • Cross-domain correlation
  • Duplicate detection
  • Coverage verification
  • Conservative causality
🎮
Tier 5

Decision Reducer & Publisher

Risk policy and safe action

  • Evaluates ValidatedSituation
  • Emits DecisionRecord
  • Proposes Action or Escalation
  • Human approval gate
// Runtime chain
Acquire → Analyze → Reconcile → Produce → Validate
// Canonical artifact lineage
Event → CoveragePlan → EvidenceShard → DomainFinding → ValidatedSituation → DecisionRecord → ProposedAction → ActionValidation → Action | Escalation

Core Design Principles

Six principles that govern every decision in ForgeMind's architecture.

01

Solve a specific problem

Every agent must solve a specific problem. If removing it leaves no meaningful capability gap, it should not exist.

02

Exchange findings, not conversations

Structured data is more reliable than long agent-to-agent prose. Design for machine-readable outputs.

03

Autonomy proportional to risk

Low-risk actions can be autonomous. High-impact actions require approval. Safety is not optional.

04

Uncertainty is a valid result

A good agent knows when to escalate. Silence is worse than a confident wrong answer.

05

Understand relationships

A PR, build failure, deployment, and incident may all be part of one engineering story.

06

Polished workflows > unfinished agents

A single end-to-end workflow that works beats ten half-built agents.

Data Model

Eight core entities that power ForgeMind's understanding of your engineering lifecycle.

Event

A change or occurrence in the engineering system

Finding

An insight derived from analysis of events

Decision

A choice made by an agent or human

Entity

A first-class object: repo, service, team, deployment

Relationship

How entities connect and influence each other

Agent

A specialized autonomous worker with a specific role

Action

An executable step taken by an agent

Escalation

A human-review boundary for high-impact decisions

Roadmap

From problem validation to production — a clear path forward.

Phase 1Current

Validate the Problems

  • Identify exact engineering pain for each agent
  • Find evidence the problem is common
  • Map existing solutions and gaps
Phase 2

Challenge Every Agent

  • Ask: if this agent disappeared, what becomes unsolved?
  • Eliminate agents without meaningful capability gaps
  • Define success metrics per agent
Phase 3

Define the MVP

  • Decide which workflows must work end-to-end
  • Build the minimum viable agent fleet
  • Validate with real engineering teams
Phase 4

Ship & Learn

  • Deploy MVP to production
  • Capture telemetry and outcomes
  • Iterate based on real usage data
